The host uses a dedicated authoritative composite-key registry and private session bindings rather than request-supplied profile extras. Proxy-policy parity remains open: direct-connection comparison successes do not establish equality under that forwarded-header upstream configuration. Origin is trusted adapter URL-origin configuration, not a body field.
